categories.main_business_segments: Fortune Brands Innovations operates three primary business segments: Water, Outdoors, and Security. The Water segment manufactures and sells faucets, accessories, kitchen sinks, and waste disposals under brands such as Moen, ROHL, and Aqualisa. The Outdoors segment produces entry door systems, storm and security doors, composite decking, and outdoor enclosures under brands like Therma-Tru, Larson, and Fiberon. The Security segment offers locks, safety and security devices, connected/mechanical lockout solutions, and safes under brands including Master Lock, Yale, August, and SentrySafe.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing and assembly processes, including automation, strategic sourcing, and machine learning to drive productivity and efficiency. It emphasizes product innovation, particularly in digital and connected products (e.g., smart home water and security solutions), and utilizes proprietary technologies protected by patents and trademarks. Key raw materials include brass, zinc, resins, steel, aluminum, wood, plastics, and glass, sourced globally.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Fortune Brands serves a diverse customer base including kitchen and bath dealers, wholesalers, professional remodelers, industrial and locksmith distributors, home centers (such as Lowe’s and The Home Depot), e-commerce, and direct-to-consumer channels. Its products are primarily targeted at the residential new construction, repair and remodel, and security markets, with a substantial focus on North America and growing international presence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in the United States, with significant sales in Canada and China, and additional presence in Europe, Mexico, Southeast Asia, South America, Africa, and Australia. In 2024, 83% of net sales were in the U.S., with the remainder in Canada, China, and other international markets. Manufacturing and distribution facilities are located across the U.S. and internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fortune Brands operates primarily as a manufacturer and assembler of branded finished goods, positioning itself downstream in the supply chain. It manages a robust global supply chain, sourcing raw materials and components, and distributing finished products through a mix of direct and indirect channels to retailers, distributors, and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include driving organic growth through innovation, expanding digital and connected product offerings, and leveraging the Fortune Brands Advantage operating model (category management, business simplification, global supply chain excellence, and digital transformation). R&D focuses on water conservation, sustainability, smart/connected products, and material conversion, with ongoing investments in automation, AI, and data analytics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of branded products to wholesalers, retailers, distributors, and direct-to-consumer channels. The company also utilizes customer programs and incentives, and has a growing presence in e-commerce and digital sales. Recurring revenue streams are supported by replacement, repair, and remodel activities in the residential market.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Masco, Kohler, LIXIL, InSinkErator, Masonite, JELD-WEN, Andersen, Trex, Azek, Abus, W.H. Brady, Kwikset, Schlage, and others, as well as private-label and imported brands. Fortune Brands positions itself as a market leader with strong brands, innovation, and customer service, competing on quality, design, technology, and channel relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Fortune Brands reported net sales of $4.6 billion and operating income of $738 million, with over 11,000 employees worldwide. The company experienced a slight sales decline (-0.4% CAGR over three years) due to market contraction, but grew operating income at a 9.1% CAGR, driven by acquisitions, productivity, and cost control. It maintains a strong balance sheet, robust cash flow, and ongoing investments in growth and shareholder returns.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Fortune Brands emphasizes its market-leading brands, innovation in smart and connected products, and commitment to quality, design, and customer service. Its value proposition centers on transforming spaces into havens, delivering products that enhance safety, sustainability, and lifestyle, and leveraging digital transformation and supply chain excellence to provide superior value to customers and channel partners.
